# aws.wrfsmn

This R package (library) was created to handle WRF SMN data obtained
from Amazon (AWS) services
(<https://registry.opendata.aws/smn-ar-wrf-dataset/>). The operational
version can be obtained from
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/aws.wrfsmn/index.html>.

## Installation

You can install the development version of aws.wrfsmn from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

### Option 1

First, the repository containing the files needed to install the package
must be cloned. From an OS terminal, run the following command:

``` R
$ git clone https://github.com/Gonzalo1985/aws.wrfsmn
```

From the folder cloned with the files of the repository, execute the
following command from an R console:

``` r

devtools::install()
```

### Option 2

From an R console run the following command:

``` r

devtools::install_github("Gonzalo1985/aws.wrfsmn")
```

Contact: Gonzalo M. Díaz (<gonzalomartindiaz22@gmail.com>)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`daily.data.fields()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/daily.data.fields.md)
  : Daily data is obtained from hourly data
- [`daily2monthly()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/daily2monthly.md)
  : Daily data to monthly
- [`eva`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/eva.md) :
  Evaporation data (observation and model)
- [`find.nearest.point()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/find.nearest.point.md)
  : Temporal series of closest location
- [`get.wrf.files()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/get.wrf.files.md)
  : List of available files for downloading
- [`ith()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/ith.md) :
  Calculation of ITH index
- [`load.by.variable()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/load.by.variable.md)
  : Load and projection of data
- [`mg.evaluation()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/mg.evaluation.md)
  : Evaluation of regression
- [`multiple.guidance()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/multiple.guidance.md)
  : Multiple lineal regression of data
- [`ploting()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/ploting.md)
  : Plot of data
- [`wrf.download()`](https://gonzalo1985.github.io/aws.wrfsmn/reference/wrf.download.md)
  : Download of wrf files
